name: Sommelier Chatbox – Wine Recommendation Widget for WooCommerce
author: winechatbox

sections.description:
Sommelier Chatbox is a free WooCommerce widget designed to improve product discovery for wine stores.

The plugin adds a floating chat-style interface to your store that guides visitors through a short, simple conversation and returns a small, focused selection of wines from your existing WooCommerce catalog.

The goal is to reduce choice overload and help customers move faster from browsing to decision, without disrupting your store layout.

This FREE version works entirely inside WordPress and WooCommerce:
– No checkout integrations
– No tracking

All recommendations are generated using deterministic rules based on your existing WooCommerce data (categories, tags, attributes, descriptions, prices, stock).

Upgrade to PRO for advanced recommendations.
Learn more about Sommelier Chatbox PRO: https://www.sommelierchatbox.com

Features

  • Floating, non-intrusive chat widget
  • Guided conversational UX
  • Deterministic product filtering using WooCommerce data
  • Displays 2–3 relevant wines per interaction
  • Uses existing product categories, tags, attributes, and prices
  • No manual tagging required
  • Fully functional as a standalone FREE plugin

Free vs Pro

Free:
– Deterministic recommendations using WooCommerce data
– 2-3 picks per request
– Runs entirely inside WordPress and stays lightweight for small to mid-size catalogs

Pro:
– AI-guided recommendations with natural replies
– Better handling of short or imperfect inputs
– Deeper catalog analysis for larger catalogs

Learn more about Sommelier Chatbox PRO: https://www.sommelierchatbox.com

How It Works

  1. The visitor opens the chat widget.
  2. The widget asks a few simple questions (occasion, taste, budget).
  3. The plugin matches keywords to WooCommerce categories, tags, attributes, and descriptions.
  4. A filtered query selects up to 3 suitable products.
  5. Results are displayed directly in the widget.

If no products match, a graceful fallback message is shown.

Usage

Once activated, the widget appears automatically on the front-end of your WooCommerce store.

No configuration is required for basic usage.

Optional settings can be configured in the WordPress admin panel to adjust the chat appearance.

Requirements

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sommelier-chatbox directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does it modify my product data?

No. It only reads existing WooCommerce data.

Is this plugin suitable for production stores?

Yes. The plugin is lightweight and does not interfere with checkout or product pages.

Does it require an API key?

No. The free version runs entirely inside WordPress and WooCommerce.

How are recommendations generated?

Deterministic rules match user input to your categories, attributes, tags, and prices.

Does it track users?

No tracking is performed by the free version.

Do you have a Pro version?

Upgrade to PRO for advanced recommendations.
Learn more about Sommelier Chatbox PRO: https://www.sommelierchatbox.com

When should I upgrade to Pro?

If you want more natural conversations or you have a large catalog and need deeper matching.
